method: Nearest station = minimum haversine (great-circle) distance, mean Earth radius 6,371,008.8 m, from each venue lat/lng to every station below (Dubai Metro Red incl. Route 2020, Green, Dubai Tram; OSM via Overpass, snapshot 2026-09-27T02:12Z, ODbL). straight_m is that distance rounded to the metre. walk_min = round(straight_m * 1.3 / 80): an estimate assuming a 1.3 street-detour factor and 80 m/min walking pace, not a routed walk. If that estimate exceeds 25 min, walk_min is null and note = "taxi from station". Venues without coordinates get no nearest_station. Stations shared by two lines (Union, BurJuman) report both lines.
